description: Validate a UiSchema or render static HTML and fragments. Use it when checking schema or patch contracts; use design_preview for a running app or schema_store to save. Returns diagnostics or rendered output. action selects validate/render; mode selects full/patch. apply:true enables rendering, without saving a schema. Render includes token CSS unless output.compact; oversized output or output.payloadMode:file writes only reply payloads. brand and scope options affect documents; ignored fragment options are diagnosed. Full schema: oods://schemas/schema_render.input.json.

action.description: Selects the per-action handler. 'render' -> schema_render action=render, 'validate' -> schema_render action=validate.

apply.description: For render: When true and the schema validates, render it: the HTML document in html, or per-node fragments with output.format 'fragments'. Actions: render, validate. See full schema for details.

baseTree.description: Required when mode='patch' to provide the base UiSchema to patch. Actions: render, validate.

brand.description: Brand to render. Actions: render. See full schema for details.

mode.description: Full schema or patch mode. Actions: render, validate.

output.description: Optional render output controls. Omitting this object preserves full-document behavior. Actions: render.

compact.description: Opt in to omitting token CSS; the default includes token CSS.
